title: Compressed a RoBERTa AI-text detector from ~500 MB to ~97 MB so it runs client-side in the browser, plus a 26 MB image detector [P]
summary: I wanted an AI text and image detector that doesn't need you to upload anything, so I took two existing open detectors and got them running fully client-side with ONNX Runtime Web. Demo: https://tinydetect.ritabratamaiti.com/ Code and scripts: https://github.com/ritabratamaiti/ti
